description: This file is a PHP source script for user management in the TestLink project. It handles user information display, password changes, API key generation, and user session management, with dependencies on external configs, classes, and functions.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user, with methods for database interactions and password management.

classes.name: APIKey
classes.description: Handles API key generation for users.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine extension used for rendering views.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments from POST and REQUEST data.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Handles changing a user's password, including validation and database update.

methods.name: generateAPIKey
methods.description: Generates a new API key for the user and logs the event.

methods.name: checkDoAction
methods.description: Validates the 'doAction' input parameter to be within allowed actions.
